quality_rules.rationale: distinct_count 16, full list under cap of 20, closed by meaning as airline codes.
distinct_count 3, full list, closed by meaning as the three NYC-area origin airports.

decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 (166158 rows all distinct) confirming whole rows are distinct, not which subset identifies; flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport all have null_rate 0.0 and together form the smallest plausible natural key for one scheduled flight occurrence; tail_number excluded as a candidate since its null_rate 0.009154 disqualifies it.

aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_seat_count, aircraft_engine_type share null_rate 0.160426 (26656 nulls); aircraft_manufacture_year has null_rate 0.176531 (29332 nulls); consistent with an unmatched join to an aircraft registry by tail_number, retained as optional.

dest_airport_name, dest_municipality, dest_iso_region, dest_elevation_ft, dest_longest_runway_ft all share null_rate 0.02089 (3471 nulls), consistent with an unmatched join to a destination airport reference table, retained as optional.

captured_at is marked is_airbyte_metadata: false, but its 16 distinct values cluster within seconds on 2026-09-02, far later than and unrelated to the 2013 flight_date range, indicating a likely pipeline ingestion timestamp rather than a flight attribute; retained and flagged for reviewer confirmation.

sched_dep_hour_local (5-23) and sched_dep_minute_local (0-59) appear to decompose sched_dep_hhmm (500-2359) into hour and minute components, though the profile does not state this derivation explicitly.

purpose: This table holds individual flight records for flights departing the three New York-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) between 2013-01-01 and 2013-06-30, combining scheduling, performance (delays, cancellation, air time), aircraft registry, and origin/destination airport reference attributes into one denormalized row per flight.
usage: Read the table at the grain of one row per (flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport). Join carrier_code to carrier_name, and origin/dest codes to their respective name, municipality, and airport-attribute columns, which are already denormalized onto each row. Treat dep_hhmm, arr_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes as null when the flight did not complete normally (consistent with is_cancelled and related nulls).
limitations: The profile cannot confirm whether sched_dep_hour_local and sched_dep_minute_local are truly derived from sched_dep_hhmm, nor the exact source or purpose of captured_at, which looks like a pipeline/ingestion timestamp unrelated to flight operations despite not being flagged as airbyte metadata; both are retained per rule 1 and flagged for reviewer confirmation. Aircraft attributes (manufacturer, model, year, seat count, engine type) and destination airport attributes are null for roughly 16-18% and 2% of rows respectively, consistent with unmatched reference joins, and their completeness cannot be further assessed from this profile. The declared grain is proposed from evidence but remains unverified until a deterministic measurement confirms it against the warehouse.
